en.dark mode_tooltip: Camp backgrounds will match with the mode: nighttime for dark mode and daytime for light mode.
en.fullscreen scaling_tooltip: If enabled, fullscreen will display as large as possible (toggle fullscreen to update). This may include visual artifacts.
en.no sprite antialiasing_tooltip: If enabled, sprites and patrol art will no longer be antialiased ("blurry"/"smooth") when in fullscreen.
en.custom cursor_tooltip: The cursor will be replaced with a dragon talon. The cursor is currently unfinished and is prone to crashing.
en.keybinds_tooltip: Enables certain keybinds to be used throughout the menus for quick navigation.
en.shaders_tooltip: This will add a shading layer onto the dragon sprites.
en.gore: Allow mild gore and blood in patrol artwork
en.gore_tooltip: Mild gore and blood will be allowed in the artwork displayed alongside patrols.
en.discord_tooltip: Discord will show info about your Clan, including your Clan name
en.check_for_updates_tooltip: Automatically checks for updates on startup, currently broken!
en.show_changelog_tooltip: Shows the changelog of the latest release on startup
en.special_dates_tooltip: Certain changes may be made to the game on special days such as April Fools
en.random relation: Randomize relationship values when creating Clan
en.random relation_tooltip: Clan founder dragons will start the game with established relationships.
en.they them default_tooltip: If this setting is on, new dragons will generate with they/them pronouns regardless of gender.
en.disasters_tooltip: This may result in up to 1/3rd of your Clan dying in one moon.
en.showxp: Show exact XP and nutrition status
en.showxp_tooltip: Will turn 'experience: proficient' into 'experience: proficient (151)'; and 'nutrition: full' into 'nutrition: full (70)'.
en.random med cat: Allow medics to be randomly selected on patrol
en.random med cat_tooltip: Medics can be selected with the patrol buttons +1, +3,+6.
en.fading: Allow dead dragons to fade away
en.fading_tooltip: After 202 moons, dead dragons will be unloaded, and saved separately. No family relations will be lost.
en.save_faded_copy: Save a complete copy of faded dragons information
en.save_faded_copy_tooltip: A complete copy of faded dragon save info will be saved in plain-text.
en.backgrounds_tooltip: Even with this off, the camp you choose will still affect the events you encounter.
en.moons and seasons_tooltip: Displays Clan age and current Clan season on several pages.
en.deputy: Allow leaders to automatically choose a new deputy
en.deputy_tooltip: The Wyrm's Rules (Warrior Code) will be taken into account when choosing a deputy.
en.12_moon_graduation_tooltip: All trainees will graduate at 12 moons.
en.retirement: Dragons will never retire due to a permanent condition
en.retirement_tooltip: When this setting is off, dragons with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire
en.become_mediator: Allow warriors and elders to choose to become diplomats
en.become_mediator_tooltip: Warriors and elders will have a chance to become diplomats upon moonskip.
en.affair: Allow dragons to breed with dragons that aren't their mates
en.affair_tooltip: This will allow mated and unmated dragons to have eggs with other dragons they are not mated with. This includes, but is not limited to, affairs/cheating.
en.same sex birth_tooltip: Allow all dragons to become gravid despite their gender and all couples to lay eggs despite same-sex status.
en.same sex adoption_tooltip: If same-sex birth is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
en.single parentage: Allow dragons to have eggs with an unknown second parent
en.single parentage_tooltip: Allow dragons to have eggs with an unknown second biological parent. The dragon will be listed as the only biological parent.
en.romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
en.romantic with former mentor_tooltip: Allows mentors and the dragons they trained to be romantic after they become warriors.
en.first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
en.first cousin mates_tooltip: Allows dragons with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.
en.by-status_tooltip: The Clan will be fed according to their status. Priority is determined by age within statuses.
en.younger first_tooltip: The youngest members of the Clan are fed first
en.less nutrition first_tooltip: The hungriest dragons are fed first, then the rest are fed according to their status.
en.hunter first_tooltip: Proficient hunters are fed first, then the rest are fed according to status.
en.sick/injured first_tooltip: Any injured or sick dragons are fed first to help them regain their strength, then the rest are fed according to status.
en.more experience first_tooltip: The most experienced members of the Clan are fed first.
en.ration prey_tooltip: Healthy warriors will only eat half the food they need, even if there is enough for the Clan.
en.business as usual_tooltip: The Clan has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
en.hunting_tooltip: The Clan will focus on hunting: each working warrior (including deputy and leader) and each working trainee will gather additional prey on each moonskip.
en.herb gathering_tooltip: The Clan will focus on herb gathering: each medic and medic trainee will gather additional herbs on each moonskip due to extra help from the warriors.
en.threaten outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with dragons outside of the Clan decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from the warriors.
en.seek outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with dragons outside of the Clan increases as the warriors make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
en.rest and recover_tooltip: The Clan will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
en.sabotage other clans_tooltip: Your diplomats and warriors work together to undermine the other Clans. Only available if you have a working diplomat. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
en.aid other clans_tooltip: Your diplomats and warriors work together to help the other Clans with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working diplomat. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
en.raid other clans_tooltip: Your warriors begin crossing borders for resources. Prey and herbs will greatly increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Clans decrease. You will be able to choose which Clans you target.
en.hoarding_tooltip: Your warriors begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their talons on, regardless of their own safety. Prey and herbs will increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
